## Veeva to Release Fiscal 2027 Third Quarter Results on December 3, 2026


November 12, 2026


PLEASANTON, Calif.


, Nov. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Veeva Systems](https://www.veeva.com/) (NYSE: VEEV) will announce financial results for its third quarter ending October 31, 2026 after market close on December 3, 2026. Veeva will host a conference call and webcast that day at 2:00 p.m. PT (5:00 p.m. ET) to discuss its financial results.


Veeva will post prepared remarks to its investor relations website at[ir.veeva.com](https://ir.veeva.com/) at approximately 1:05 p.m. PT (4:05 p.m. ET). A webcast replay will be available on the website following the live event.


Event:


Veeva Systems' Fiscal 2027 Third Quarter Results Conference Call


Date:


Thursday, December 3, 2026


Time:


2:00 p.m. PT (5:00 p.m. ET)


Conference Call Registration:


[https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/350399389?pwd=a4JgxcEo](https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/350399389?pwd=a4JgxcEo)


Webcast:


[ir.veeva.com](https://ir.veeva.com/investors/investor-overview/default.aspx)


**About Veeva Systems** Veeva delivers the industry cloud for life sciences with applications, agents, data, and consulting. Committed to innovation, product excellence, and customer success, Veeva serves more than 1,500 customers, ranging from the world's largest pharmaceutical companies to emerging biotechs. As a[Public Benefit Corporation](https://www.veeva.com/pbc/) , Veeva is committed to balancing the interests of all stakeholders, including customers, employees, shareholders, and the industries it serves. For more information, visit[veeva.com](http://veeva.com/) .


Veeva uses its[ir.veeva.com](http://ir.veeva.com/) website as a means of disclosing material non-public information, announcing upcoming investor conferences, and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Accordingly, you should monitor Veeva's investor relations website in addition to following its press releases, SEC filings, and public conference calls and webcasts.
